Manipur Students Protest Demanding NRC Before Census

Students in Manipur held protests and a torch rally demanding the implementation of the National Register of Citizens (NRC) before the census is conducted. A 48-hour bandh was also called, with women vendors and students participating. The demonstrations took place outside the census directorate.
